plugin_lol_description: This match's 10 players' history, anyone's match history, the summoner spells the enemy used; champion strength, counters, builds and ARAM Mayhem augments
plugin_lol_source_client_desc: Reads League of Legends' local client and in-game APIs (read-only, nothing is changed) to look up the history of this match's players and track the summoner spells the enemy used; the game center uses it to know about champion select, loading, in-game phases and what happens in the game.
plugin_lol_source_client_risk: On the Chinese (Tencent) servers this kind of feature may break Tencent's user agreement; tools like LeagueAkari have reports of bans and chat mutes, and Riot restricts third-party cooldown timers. Whether to use it is your call.
plugin_lol_settings_intro: {companion} needs the switches below to read this match's data. Changes apply right away; {companion}'s tool list follows from the next conversation.
plugin_lol_game_section_desc: Match history and summoner spells for this game come from the League of Legends plugin.
plugin_lol_game_section_open: Open the League of Legends plugin
plugin_lol_events_off: The League of Legends plugin's "Read client data" is off: only the generic events arrive (start, close, window switches, match start and end), not phases like champion select or loading, nor in-game events.
plugin_lol_push_opening_when: During loading, once all 10 players' stats are in (at most 20 seconds)
plugin_lol_push_opening_what: Posts a card with both teams' stats and leaves her a short note
plugin_lol_push_summary_when: At the end of the match, once the result is in
plugin_lol_push_summary_what: Posts a match summary card (match details; in Mayhem and Arena it also lists each enemy's augments) and leaves her a short note
plugin_lol_push_today_when: When you're in a lobby or queueing (only if you've played today)
plugin_lol_push_today_what: Posts a card: today's wins and losses, your current win / losing streak, champions you lost 2 or more games with today; one card a day, updated in place when you're back in the lobby after a game
plugin_lol_push_champ_select_when: During champ select: when it starts and each time someone swaps or rerolls
plugin_lol_push_champ_select_what: Posts a card: on the Rift, each player's lane tier, ban candidates after you pre-pick, team-comp counts, your champion pool when it's your pick, the lane matchup once you lock, and your champion's runes, build, skill order and summoner spells (one-click import); in Mayhem, your team's grades and win rates, the bench champions better than yours, and your champion's best augments and build. Updated in place during one champ select; leaves her a short note when it ends
plugin_lol_push_augment_pick_when: In a Mayhem game, when the augment choice shows up and each reroll
plugin_lol_push_augment_pick_what: Posts a card with one verdict per augment, left to right: top pick / fine / reroll (AramHex's rules), updated in place on reroll; she says “the middle one” when the cards appear and when the best one changes. Needs local text recognition: asks once whether to download it and says in one line when it can't run
plugin_lol_push_enemy_ult_when: An enemy with a global or long-range ultimate (Twisted Fate, Nocturne, Pantheon, Shen, Karthus, Ashe, Ezreal…) or, on the Rift, your lane opponent reaches level 6
plugin_lol_push_enemy_ult_what: She says “Twisted Fate is level 6” and shows one line
plugin_lol_push_enemy_item_when: An enemy finishes Guardian Angel, Zhonya's Hourglass, Quicksilver or Banshee's Veil; when you play a healing champion, an enemy buys Grievous Wounds
plugin_lol_push_enemy_item_what: She says “Yasuo bought Guardian Angel” and shows one line
plugin_lol_push_spell_ready_when: A summoner spell you or she marked is back up (say “their mid flashed” in game and she marks it)
plugin_lol_push_spell_ready_what: She says “Mid's Flash is up” and shows one line
plugin_lol_push_objective_when: 30 seconds before Dragon, Elder Dragon, Voidgrubs, Rift Herald or Baron spawns on the Rift (this season's timers)
plugin_lol_push_objective_what: She says “Dragon in 30 seconds” and shows one line
plugin_lol_push_enemies_down_when: Three or more enemies are dead at once
plugin_lol_push_enemies_down_what: She says “three enemies down, first back in 18 seconds” and shows one line
plugin_lol_push_my_death_what: Posts a card: each enemy's level, KDA and items (ordered by item value), with what they bought since your last death marked; one card per game, updated in place on every death
plugin_lol_game_section_plugin_off: The League of Legends plugin is off: turn it on first under Plugins in the left sidebar.
plugin_lol_search_placeholder: Name#tag, or a champion or player in this match
plugin_lol_card_more: {count} more games — open to see all
plugin_lol_source_stats_desc: Looks up League of Legends stats on the web (Chinese servers): Tencent 101 / Zhangmeng tier lists, counters, builds, runes, skill orders and the ARAM Mayhem champion ranking; czgreat/aramhex-data's ARAM Mayhem champion × augment win rates; Tencent's champion nicknames. Requested only on demand (when a page opens or she asks), never with your account.
plugin_lol_source_stats_risk: The data comes from unofficial Tencent and aramhex endpoints with no documentation that may change or stop at any time. Riot's rule: "Products cannot display win rates for Augments or Arena Mode items. This applies to all websites, applications and overlays." (developer.riotgames.com/docs/lol) The ARAM Mayhem augment-pick verdicts and augment win rates fall under it; showing them in chat or the floating window carries the same risk.
plugin_lol_source_opgg_desc: Uses global data from OP.GG's official MCP (champion builds and counter analysis, Mayhem augments): requested only when you switch a page's source to OP.GG or she looks something up, at most 2 at a time, cached for 24 hours; the page shows OP.GG's logo and a link.
plugin_lol_source_opgg_risk: OP.GG hasn't yet agreed to Kotone using its data (github.com/opgginc/opgg-mcp/issues/26), and its site terms forbid automated access. If you'd rather not, turn it off; champion pages still have Tencent 101 data.
plugin_lol_champion_search_placeholder: Champion name, title or nickname (Irelia, Yasuo)
plugin_lol_champion_empty: Enter a champion to see its strength, counters, builds and ARAM Mayhem augments.
plugin_lol_augments_note: Numbers are how many percentage points {champion}'s win rate with this augment is above its average (small samples are pulled toward the average).
plugin_lol_champ_select_empty: During champ select this shows each teammate's win rate and tier (and, in Mayhem, the bench champions better than yours).
plugin_lol_cs_bans_hint_with: {lane}: hardest for {champion}, and this patch's strongest
plugin_lol_cs_comp_rule: Counted from the client's champion data: tanks or durability 3/3 count as frontline, crowd control 3/3 as hard CC
plugin_lol_cs_pool_hint: From your recent Rift games, against their locked picks
plugin_lol_cs_pool_none: No matchup data against their locked picks
plugin_lol_cs_matchup_guessed: The opponent is a guess: their most-picked champion in this lane
plugin_lol_cs_import_what: Writes the rune page, item set and summoner spells into the client
plugin_lol_cs_import_what_mayhem: Writes the item set and summoner spells into the client (this data has no runes)
plugin_lol_cs_import_off: Turn on “Control the client” in the plugin settings first (off by default)
plugin_lol_cs_import_ended: Champ select is over; nothing to import now
plugin_lol_cs_import_not_now: Not in champ select right now
plugin_lol_cs_runes_no_room: No rune page you can edit (only default pages)
plugin_lol_cs_spells_no_data: This data has no summoner spells
plugin_lol_cs_spells_not_now: Summoner spells can only be changed during champ select
plugin_lol_augment_ocr_ask: Augment scores need a local text recognition model (about {size} MB). Download it?
plugin_lol_augment_ocr_why: During the Mayhem augment choice Kotone looks at the three cards once a second, only with the model on your computer; screenshots are not uploaded. Downloading does not change your choice in Settings → Models → Text recognition.
plugin_lol_augment_ocr_ready: Done: the next augment choice will show scores.
plugin_lol_augment_ocr_declined: Not downloading. To use it later, download a local model in Settings → Models → Text recognition.
plugin_lol_pick_weak: All three are weak; reroll if you can
plugin_lol_death_order: Ordered by the value of their items
plugin_lol_source_control_desc: Controls the League of Legends client the way LeagueAkari does: accepts matches automatically and picks / bans champions automatically in the order you set; she accepts a match or picks / bans a champion for you only when you say so; runes, an item set and summoner spells are written only when you press Import on the champ-select card. Reads and writes go only through the client's own local API — no game memory reading, no injection. "Read client data" must be on too.
plugin_lol_source_control_risk: Players on other servers were permanently banned after using auto-accept and auto-pick (LeagueAkari's github.com/LeagueAkari/LeagueAkari/issues/523), and on the Chinese servers it may break Tencent's user agreement. Off by default; turning it on means you accept this risk yourself.
plugin_lol_source_chat_desc: In champion select and in the lobby, what you say with voice input and what she sends for you goes out through the client's own local chat API, with no key presses (the way LeagueAkari does it). Several lines go out as one message. It only sends when you speak, ask her to send, or a hotkey or automation you set up sends. "Read client data" must be on too.
plugin_lol_source_chat_risk: On the Chinese servers third-party tools may break Tencent's user agreement; messages sent through the API still go through Tencent's word filter and chat-ban rules (LeagueAkari users reported template words being filtered: github.com/LeagueAkari/LeagueAkari/issues/480; WeGame removed its editable one-key callouts: github.com/LeagueAkari/LeagueAkari/issues/524). Riot says the client API is not officially supported for third-party use (developer.riotgames.com/docs/lol). With it off, she won't send for you in champion select; your own voice input still types into the window in front.
plugin_lol_notice_aramhex_data_body: ARAM Mayhem champion × augment win rates come from czgreat/aramhex-data under CC BY-NC 4.0: credit the source, no commercial use. Kotone is free, and every page that uses this data credits it.
plugin_lol_notice_opgg_body: Global data (champion builds and counter analysis) comes from OP.GG's official MCP. The usage we promised in the issue: request only on demand, at most 2 at a time, cache for 24 hours, say in each request that it's Kotone, show OP.GG's logo and a link on the page, and she names the source when she uses it.
plugin_lol_notice_images_body: Champion icons, items, augments and other images are taken from the League client on your computer first, and from CommunityDragon (a community mirror of the client's assets) when the client isn't running; none of them ship in the installer. The images belong to Riot Games.
plugin_lol_notice_riot_body: Kotone was created under Riot Games' "Legal Jibber Jabber" policy using assets owned by Riot Games. Riot Games does not endorse or sponsor this project.
plugin_lol_control_intro: Like LeagueAkari: accept matches automatically and pick / ban champions in the order you set. Changes apply right away.
plugin_lol_control_off: Turn on "Control the client" above first; these preferences only apply while it's on.
plugin_lol_control_needs_client: "Read client data" is off: controlling the client needs to read it too, so turn that on first.
plugin_lol_control_accept_desc: Clicks "Accept" once a match is found; if you already accepted or declined, it does nothing.
plugin_lol_control_pick_desc: On your pick turn, takes the first champion from the top that can be picked (banned or taken ones are skipped).
plugin_lol_control_lock_desc: When off, it only shows the champion and you lock in yourself.
plugin_lol_control_ban_desc: On your ban turn, bans the first champion from the top that can be banned; already-banned champions and a teammate's wish are skipped.
plugin_lol_control_list_empty: No champions yet; search below to add some.
plugin_lol_control_add_placeholder: Search a champion to add (name or title)
plugin_lol_control_note: Follows LeagueAkari's rules: skips champions that are banned or taken, never bans a teammate's wish, and acts once per turn. Reads and writes go only through the client's own local API — no game memory reading, no injection.
plugin_lol_foot_riot: Kotone was created under Riot Games' "Legal Jibber Jabber" policy using assets owned by Riot Games. Riot Games does not endorse or sponsor this project.
plugin_lol_names_hidden_note: Names are hidden in ranked champ select. Enemies and hidden teammates are looked up once loading starts.
plugin_lol_not_in_game: Not in a match right now. Once champ select starts, the players show up here.
plugin_lol_result_missing: Couldn't get the result. Check your match history.
plugin_lol_start_records: Records at the start of the match
plugin_lol_today_capped: Only your last {count} games were checked
plugin_lol_today_empty: When you're in a lobby or queueing, this shows how many games you played today, your wins and losses and your current streak.
plugin_lol_state_ambiguous: Several players match. Search with the full "name#tag".
plugin_lol_state_champ_select: Still in champ select. Once loading starts, all 10 players' records show up here.
plugin_lol_state_client_closed: The League of Legends client isn't open. This page updates once it is.
plugin_lol_state_disabled: Turn on this page's data switch in settings first.
plugin_lol_state_error: Couldn't read it. Try Refresh in a moment.
plugin_lol_state_loading: The game is still loading. This page updates once you're in.
plugin_lol_state_not_found: Not found. Try another spelling (name#tag, champion name or nickname).
plugin_lol_identity_hidden_desc: This player hid their identity: the client gives no name or history, so nothing is looked up.
plugin_lol_source_menu_rift: Source for Summoner's Rift champion data
plugin_lol_source_needs_opgg: Turn on “Use OP.GG data” in settings first
plugin_lol_source_not_saved: Switched for now, but not remembered: Kotone's settings can't be changed here
